qs.q: A patient on opioid analgesia develops postoperative nausea; which antiemetic is most appropriate as first‑line therapy?
qs.e: Ondansetron is the preferred first‑line antiemetic for opioid‑induced nausea. The other agents are alternatives but not the initial choice.

qs.q: Ondansetron is used as an antiemetic primarily because it
qs.e: Ondansetron is a selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist. Blocking 5-HT3 receptors in the chemoreceptor trigger zone and vagal afferents effectively prevents nausea and vomiting, particularly from chemotherapy and post-operative settings.
